Resources

Logos, research files and data, in one place

Download the mark and wordmark, the data behind every figure, and the list of research files in the repository.

LogoResearch filesData

01Logo

The mark is an RNA hairpin

One strand of RNA folded back on itself: the molecule that may once have both carried information and copied it. Use it on light backgrounds as drawn; on dark ones, use the lighter teal from the site's dark theme.

  • open-origins-mark.svgThe mark alone
  • open-origins-wordmark.svgMark and name; the name uses the system sans

02Files

Every result has a file you can rerun

Each path links to the file in the public repository.

  • experiments/assembly_null/RESULTS.mdAssembly index beats size on small molecules, but in the wrong direction (task #7)
  • experiments/compat/RESULTS.mdStep-compatibility rule: sealed, and the scorer catches the planted incompatible step
  • experiments/luca_planted/RESULTS.mdPlanted LUCA recovery on simulated trees (task #9): results
  • experiments/pathway_map/RESULTS.mdPathway map: no route is continuous, and no hand-off between two published steps passes cleanly
  • experiments/qt45_numbers/RESULTS.mdQT45: net replication is far below 1 per cycle (task #2)
  • experiments/raf/RESULTS.mdPlanted autocatalytic core: always found, but maxRAF size only flags large cores, and two of four nulls are invalid
  • experiments/raf_null/RESULTS.mdThe 1,335-reaction RAF in anaerobic metabolism is no larger than its nulls give: negative
  • experiments/research_sweep/RESULTS.mdResearch sweep and citation audit (tasks #1 and #14)
  • docs/PLAN.mdThe research plan and the 2027 targets
  • docs/AGENT_BRIEF.mdRules of evidence every agent follows
  • docs/PAPERS.csvThe paper ledger
  • docs/NEGATIVE_ATLAS.mdClosed routes, each with the effect size its test could have caught; empty so far
  • docs/prereg/Sealed plans; their hashes are in HASHES.txt

03Data

The data behind every figure, free to download

  • PAPERS.csvPaper ledger, every row resolved by DOI · 20 KB
  • pathway_map.jsonPathway map: steps, hand-offs, verdicts and ranked gaps · 80 KB
  • pathway_handoffs.csvEvery hand-off with its verdict and flags · 4 KB
  • qt45_results_calc.jsonQT45 growth-factor calculation · 2 KB
  • compat_planted_cases.csvThe 28 planted cases for the compatibility rule · 2 KB
  • catalog.csvDataset catalogue: every relevant dataset, its terms, and whether we use it · 27 KB
Open Origins
